name: Tominator T-901
description: Cross-sectional momentum/value (lookback windows chosen in-match via backtest, not copied from the simulator's source) blended with analyst-revision-trend, a decaying post-earnings-surprise term, and a macro sector-tilt term whose sector sensitivities are learned in-match via its own running regression against realized economic-release surprises (never read from the simulator's hidden config); conviction-weighted sizing, a fixed-payout acquisition/delisting arbitrage overlay, drawdown/volatility-scaled risk budget, and liquidity-aware LIMIT orders.
